# Universal QR & Barcode Generator - Full Technical Specification

> Complete technical dictionary, mathematical algorithms, character encodings, and validation rules for AI search agents and developer integrations.

## 1. Mathematical Checksum Routines

### GS1 Modulo-10 Check Digit (EAN-13, UPC-A, ITF-14, EAN-8)
Used to calculate the final verification digit for retail and shipping barcodes:
- EAN-13 (12 data digits + 1 check digit): Weighting pattern alternate [1, 3, 1, 3...].
- UPC-A (11 data digits + 1 check digit): Weighting pattern alternate [3, 1, 3, 1...].
- ITF-14 (13 data digits + 1 check digit): Weighting pattern alternate [3, 1, 3, 1...].
Formula: Check Digit = (10 - (Sum of weighted digits % 10)) % 10.

### Code 128 Modulo-103 Check Character
Sum of (start character value + Σ(character value × character position 1..N)) % 103. Automatically calculated and embedded by bwip-js engine.

## 2. Symbology Specifications

### QR Code (Quick Response Code)
- Standard: ISO/IEC 18004
- Max Capacity: 7,089 numeric, 4,296 alphanumeric, 2,953 binary bytes
- Error Correction: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30% - required when center logo is embedded)

### Data Matrix (ECC 200)
- Standard: ISO/IEC 16022
- Max Capacity: 3,116 numeric, 2,335 alphanumeric
- Finder Pattern: Solid "L" on left and bottom edges; alternating timing pattern on top and right edges
- Aspect Ratio: Fixed 1:1 square matrix

### Aztec Code
- Standard: ISO/IEC 24778
- Max Capacity: 3,832 numeric, 3,067 alphanumeric
- Finder Pattern: Concentric square bullseye pattern at exact center
- Quiet Zone: 0X (no quiet zone required)

### PDF417
- Standard: ISO/IEC 15438
- Type: 2D stacked linear barcode
- Codeword Structure: 17 modules wide with 4 bars and 4 spaces
- Aspect Ratio: Nominal 2.5:1 to 3.0:1

### EAN-13
- Standard: ISO/IEC 15420
- Digits: Exactly 13 numeric digits (0-9)
- Quiet Zones: 11X module width left, 7X module width right

### UPC-A
- Standard: GS1 US / ISO/IEC 15420
- Digits: Exactly 12 numeric digits (0-9)
- Quiet Zones: 9X module width left and right

### Code 128
- Standard: ISO/IEC 15417
- Character Set: Full ASCII 128 (Codes 0 to 127)
- Subsets: A (Caps + Control), B (Standard alphanumeric), C (Double-density paired digits 00-99)

### ITF-14
- Standard: ISO/IEC 16390
- Digits: Exactly 14 numeric digits (0-9)
- Enclosure: Thick horizontal bearer bars (4.8mm nominal) on top and bottom

## 3. Smart QR Payload Syntax

### Wi-Fi Network Auto-Connect
```
WIFI:S:<SSID>;T:<WPA|WEP|nopass>;P:<PASSWORD>;H:<true|false>;;
```
Special characters `;`, `:`, `\`, `,` and `"` are escaped with a preceding backslash `\`.

### vCard 3.0 Digital Contact
```
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:LastName;FirstName;;;
FN:FirstName LastName
ORG:Company Name
TITLE:Job Title
TEL;TYPE=CELL:+1234567890
EMAIL;TYPE=WORK:user@example.com
URL:https://example.com
END:VCARD
```

### Cryptocurrency Wallets
- Bitcoin: `bitcoin:<address>?amount=<val>&label=<name>`
- Ethereum: `ethereum:<address>?value=<val>`
- Solana: `solana:<address>?amount=<val>`

### iCalendar VEVENT
```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
SUMMARY:Conference
LOCATION:Main Hall
DTSTART:20261015T090000Z
DTEND:20261015T170000Z
DESCRIPTION:Annual Tech Summit
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```
